name: pixpilot-js-utils-mcp

tools.name: list_packages
tools.description: One row per package in the @pixpilot utility packages: description, category, entry points with their runtime, utility count, and install command. Use it to browse by domain; use search_utilities to find a specific helper.

tools.name: search_utilities
tools.description: Find utilities in the @pixpilot utility packages by what they do, in a few words, or by name. Returns compact matches ranked by relevance: name, package, import path, runtime, signature, one-line summary, and the query terms each matched. `unmatchedTerms` lists query words no result covers. An empty query with `package` lists that package.

query.description: Task description or utility name. Empty lists utilities.

package.description: Limit to one package or import path, e.g. "@pixpilot/array", "array", "@pixpilot/env/node".

runtime.description: Where the code runs; "browser" or "node" also include universal utilities.

tools.name: get_utility_details
tools.description: Full documentation for one utility: signatures with parameter and return types, option object properties, examples, notes, runtime, import statement, and install command.

package.description: Package or import path, only needed when the name exists in several packages.

instructions:
Catalog of the @pixpilot JavaScript/TypeScript utility packages: strings and case conversion, arrays, objects (deep merge, dot paths, key casing), dates, numbers, money formatting, pagination, env/.env loading, DOM z-index, GUID checks, hashing, and finding project roots.

Consult it BEFORE hand-writing a small general-purpose helper, then install and import the package that already provides it.

Workflow: `search_utilities` with a short task description -> `get_utility_details` for the exact signature, parameters, examples, import statement, and install command. `list_packages` gives a one-screen overview. Respect `runtime`: "node" utilities must not be used in browser code. Install with the project's package manager.
